# **E210**: Proto message name may not exceed a length limit

## Description

Proto message names may not be longer than 127 characters.

## Rationale (Why is this bad?)

**Comm Stack Limit**: The underlying communication stack sets a limit of 127
characters for names to ensure they fit within fixed-size buffers.
While the proto message name itself might be part of a larger FQIN,
long names can cause the final unit type name to exceed the limit.

## Error Example

```proto
message  {
  option (.sdv.vsidl.v1.publication) = {
    model: SINGLE_PUB
    message_count: 8
  };
  // ...
}
```

## How to Fix

Shorten the proto message name to be at most 127 characters.
